title: Dadi Ka Nyaay
style: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with a 40mm anamorphic lens, dramatic motivated lighting with a soft rim light, rich warm-and-teal colour grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, moody atmosphere, beautiful young Indian people with clear natural light wheatish skin, expressive emotional faces and sharp detailed eyes, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: Priya, young, warm, relatable. Long soft wavy dark-brown hair, natural makeup, small bindi, elegant pastel kurta, fair skin.

Rohan.look: Handsome, kind, caring young man. Short, neat dark hair, simple shirt, light wheatish skin.

Dadi.look: Old, wise, gentle face, silver hair in a neat bun, spectacles, simple traditional saree, clear skin.

Elder.look: Old, respected village elder. White hair and beard, traditional kurta-pajama, wise expression.

scenes.image: Priya (narrator), young, warm, in a pastel kurta, sitting alone on a wooden bench in a sunlit courtyard, looking devastated, tears in her eyes. Head bowed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: मेरी दादी ने मेरे प्यार को तोड़ा।
scenes.say: मेरी दादी ने मेरे प्यार को तोड़ा।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan, young, laughing happily, walking hand-in-hand through a vibrant flower field. Both smiling brightly, warm light.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: रोहन मेरा बचपन का प्यार था।
scenes.say: रोहन मेरा बचपन का प्यार था।

scenes.image: Dadi (old, wise, gentle), in a simple saree, hands a set of old, rustic keys to Rohan. Rohan looks respectful and grateful. Priya watches fondly. Set in Dadi's ancestral home veranda.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: दादी ने उसे अपनी ज़मीन सौंपी।
scenes.sub: Dadi entrusted him with her land.
scenes.say: दादी ने उसे अपनी ज़मीन सौंपी।

scenes.image: Dadi, sitting alone on a charpai, looking frail and melancholic, staring into the distance in the ancestral home. The home looks quiet and slightly neglected.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi's face, a single tear rolling down her cheek, looking sad. Priya's hand gently rests on Dadi's shoulder, concerned.
scenes.speaker: Dadi

scenes.image: Priya, conflicted, looking between a framed photo of her and Rohan smiling, and Dadi sitting alone in the distance. Her face shows deep worry and internal struggle.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: मेरा दिल दो हिस्सों में बँट गया।
scenes.sub: My heart was split in two.
scenes.say: मेरा दिल दो हिस्सों में बँट गया।

scenes.image: Priya confronting Rohan in the ancestral garden, her expression serious and concerned. Rohan looks surprised, slightly defensive.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: Rohan, with a troubled expression, turning away from Priya. Priya looks hurt and confused, trying to understand.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: उसने कुछ नहीं बताया, बस इनकार किया।
scenes.sub: He didn't say anything, just denied it.
scenes.say: उसने कुछ नहीं बताया, बस इनकार किया।

scenes.image: Priya, with a determined yet pained expression, walks purposefully towards the village elder's traditional house. It's a clear, brave step.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: मैंने न्याय चुना, चाहे कुछ भी हो।
scenes.sub: I chose justice, no matter what.
scenes.say: मैंने न्याय चुना, चाहे कुछ भी हो।

scenes.image: The village elder (an old, wise man) sitting in the center, flanked by Dadi on one side and Rohan and Priya on the other, in a traditional panchayat setting. Rohan looks tense.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: न्याय के लिए मैंने पंचायत बुलाई।
scenes.sub: For justice, I called the panchayat.
scenes.say: न्याय के लिए मैंने पंचायत बुलाई।

scenes.image: Close-up of the Elder, his face grave, making a pronouncement. Rohan looks shocked and deeply hurt. Priya looks devastated and conflicted.
scenes.speaker: Elder
scenes.line: बड़े ने रोहन के खिलाफ फैसला सुनाया।
scenes.say: बड़े ने रोहन के खिलाफ फैसला सुनाया।

scenes.image: Rohan, looking angry and betrayed, walking away from Priya, who is standing alone, clutching her chest, tears streaming down her face. A small engagement ring lies on the ground near her feet.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: रोहन ने हमारी सगाई तोड़ दी।
scenes.say: रोहन ने हमारी सगाई तोड़ दी।

scenes.image: Dadi gently embracing a sobbing Priya. Dadi's face is now full of love and a knowing, soft smile, not sadness. Priya is still crying but looks up in confusion.
scenes.speaker: Dadi

scenes.image: Dadi holding Priya's hand, explaining with a soft, wise expression. Priya looks up, confused but listening intently, realization dawning on her face.
scenes.speaker: Dadi

scenes.image: Rohan and Priya, reunited, holding hands, looking into each other's eyes with deep love and understanding, smiling through happy tears. Dadi smiles warmly in the background, witnessing their reunion.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: रोहन लौटा, प्यार सच्चा साबित हुआ।
scenes.say: रोहन लौटा, प्यार सच्चा साबित हुआ।

scenes.image: Priya (narrator), looking directly at the camera, a thoughtful, gentle expression, inviting the viewer's opinion.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: दादी का यह तरीक़ा सही था क्या?
scenes.say: दादी का यह तरीक़ा सही था क्या?

caption: My Dadi Broke My Engagement... But She Had A Secret Plan 💔
yt_title: My Dadi Broke My Engagement... But She Had A Secret Plan 💔
description: My Dadi seemingly broke my heart and my love for Rohan. I accused him of neglect, choosing justice over everything. But Dadi had a secret plan all along. Dadi ka yeh tareeka sahi tha kya? Haan ya Na?
comment_question: Dadi ka yeh tareeka sahi tha kya? Haan ya Na?
